name: boot_chain
description: Run psibase boot -a <api_url> -p <producer> against an already-running unbooted node.

api_url.description: Full HTTP URL for psibase boot -a (e.g. http://psibase.localhost:8080/). Use a hostname that supports per-service subdomains (psibase boot constructs URLs like accounts.<host>); plain IPs like 127.0.0.1 will fail with DNS errors.

http_host.description: Host used with listen_port when api_url is omitted. Must support per-service subdomains.

admin_ip.description: If set, adds PSIBASE_ADMIN_IP for the boot subprocess.
